description:
Parent: fz-kdt

Found by fz-kdt.69.3's build (measured, reproduced): rebuild_coalesced_call_
emission (jobs/semantic.rs:1119-1206) re-mints a target from merged inputs
and publishes ONLY the rebuilt key, while rebuilt_activations.extend(
call.activations) keeps the pre-coalesce keys flowing through the parallel
contribution channel. The walk's own return evidence and value_types come
from the PRE-coalesce callees' ReturnType -- so the published edge and the
analysis's actual dependencies disagree. Measured: 13/0/4 coalesce events
per drive lose an activation key (take_drop/range_map/predicate); deriving
demand from edges alone starves the ROOT's own analysis into a transport
panic on both fixtures that lose keys.

Fix: either the rebuilt edge carries every walked activation, or the walk
uses the rebuilt key -- today's split is a latent correctness smell
independent of fz-kdt.69 (the published boundary lies about the evidence).
PREREQUISITE for fz-kdt.69.3 (demand from live edges); see the WIP reference
branch wt/kdt693-index (9d65ab25e).

## UNBLOCKS

- ○ fz-kdt.69.3 P1 Demand is derived from live edges; preservation machinery deleted

## Cold-review verification + acceptance (2026-08-31)
Independently reproduced with a wider 'walked' definition: 337/30/203
coalesce events/drive, 81/0/62 losing a depended-on activation, 10/0/10
distinct keys lost (recipe: fz2 build debug, per-event probe). Acceptance:
RED -- assert the published CallSiteSummary names every activation the walk
read a ReturnType from; the loss events go to zero. Pins 59/221/214 +
canonical byte-compare + zero-uncaused hold. PARK/STOP: if the honest fix
MOVES the artifact, that is the finding -- the artifact today depends on the
discrepancy; stop and decide the artifact question explicitly, do not patch
around it.
title: Coalesced call edges do not name every activation the walk used
